review_evidence: README identifies the repository as the Lean 4 version of the ProofNet dataset.

formal/Artin.lean, formal/Axler.lean, formal/Dummit-Foote.lean, formal/Munkres.lean, formal/Rudin.lean and the other formal/* modules contain hundreds of explicit exercise theorem statements; the unit-wide declaration scan found 371 declarations.
These formalized textbook/problem statements are independently searchable mathematical prior art, irrespective of whether individual benchmark exercises have complete proofs.
summary: Retain ProofNet-lean4: it is a large textbook-exercise theorem corpus spanning algebra, analysis, topology, number theory, and competition mathematics.
